answer: Random beacon checks plus a compute heartbeat stop bulk fakes. Each agent posts a 25-credit onyx bond and proves live compute by a heartbeat every 10 minutes as it wanders between clients. Each epoch the beacon draws 5% for a 60-second challenge; failure freezes the bond and strips the violet badge. 100 fakes cost 2,500 credits in bonds plus 200 per epoch in compute, vs 120 earned, so fakes lose money. Honest agents pay once, keep full earnings.
